summary: Planned FormalSystem/Metalogic/LCExtension.lean in three phases: the module plus its two aggregator imports; the Tests/BimodalTest axiom-profile evidence module; then the theorem-index rows, regenerated inventory blocks, and the full gate set. The plan's Lean Challenge Statements block (fourteen identifiers) was compiled standalone with lake env lean in this dispatch, exit 0, which also fixed the exact three-import list Phase 1 needs instead of the probe's blanket import FormalSystem. The declared file scope grows from the task's four paths to ten: the research report judged the three READMEs and typst/generated/status.typ unnecessary, but the pre-commit count-freshness gate and check-module-invariants.sh's INV check both force them.
